items.exampleEn: He never shies away from hard questions.
items.exampleZh: 他從不迴避困難的問題。

items.exampleEn: Could you spell out exactly what you need?
items.exampleZh: 你可以詳細說明你到底需要什麼嗎？

items.exampleEn: Most of our problems stem from poor communication.
items.exampleZh: 我們大部分的問題都源於溝通不良。

items.exampleEn: Scientists sometimes stumble upon important discoveries by chance.
items.exampleZh: 科學家有時會偶然發現重要的事物。

items.exampleEn: Good teachers tap into students' natural curiosity.
items.exampleZh: 好老師會善用學生天生的好奇心。

items.exampleEn: These issues were only touched on in the report.
items.exampleZh: 這些議題在報告中只被略微提及。

items.exampleEn: She got two job offers and weighed them up carefully.
items.exampleZh: 她拿到兩份工作邀約，仔細權衡了一番。

items.sentenceEn: Her fear of dogs stems from a bad experience as a child.
items.sentenceZh: 她怕狗是源於小時候一次不好的經驗。

items.audioEn: The manager spelled out the new rules so that nobody would be confused.
items.audioZh: 經理把新規定詳細說明清楚，這樣才不會有人搞不懂。
items.questionZh: 經理為什麼詳細說明新規定？
options: Because the rules were very old
To make the meeting last longer

items.sentenceEn: Many cities are tapping into solar power.
items.sentenceZh: 許多城市正在開發太陽能。

items.sentenceEn: Don't shy away from asking for help.

items.stemEn: Before you decide, ____ the risks against the benefits.
items.stemZh: 做決定之前，先權衡風險和好處。

items.stemEn: While walking in the hills, we ____ a small, beautiful lake.
items.stemZh: 在山上散步時，我們偶然發現一座美麗的小湖。

items.passageEn: While researching her family history, the journalist Rosa stumbled upon a diary written by her great-grandfather. In it, he described his life as a fisherman and touched on the hardships of those difficult years. Rosa realized that many of her family's traditions stem from that period. She decided to write a book about it, tapping into her relatives' memories and old newspapers. Her editor said that readers must know which parts were facts and which were her own guesses, so she should spell it out clearly. The book is expected to come out early next autumn.
items.passageZh: 記者 Rosa 在研究家族歷史時，偶然發現了一本曾祖父寫的日記。日記裡，他描述了自己當漁夫的生活，也略微提到了那段艱困歲月裡的苦難。Rosa 發現，家裡的許多傳統都源於那個時期。她決定寫一本書，利用親戚們的回憶和舊報紙來撰寫。她的編輯說，讀者必須知道哪些部分是事實、哪些是她自己的猜測，所以她應該清楚說明。這本書預計明年初秋出版。

questions.questionZh: Rosa 在研究家族歷史時發現了什麼？
編輯要 Rosa 做什麼？
options: 在書裡加入更多老照片
多訪問幾位住在國外的親戚
把日記全文翻譯成英文

items.promptZh: 老師上課時只稍微提到這個主題。
referenceEn: The teacher only touched on this topic in class.
In class, the teacher only touched on this subject.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「稍微提到」（例如 only touched on this topic 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 only briefly mentioned this topic 等）
時態可用過去式、現在完成式或表示習慣的現在式（例如 touched on、has touched on、touches on 等）

items.promptZh: 做決定前，我們應該權衡所有的選擇。
referenceEn: Before making a decision, we should weigh up all the options.
We should weigh up all our options before we decide.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「權衡」（例如 weigh up all the options 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 weigh、consider、think carefully about all the options 等）
「應該」可寫，例如 should、ought to 等
「做決定前」可寫，例如 before making a decision、before we decide 等
